task: Classify nodal stage risk in non-small cell lung cancer. Classes: node negative vs. node positive. Helpful H&E indicators of nodal spread include lymphovascular invasion, infiltrative growth, pleural invasion, poor differentiation, and other aggressive features associated with metastatic potential.

classes.0: Node-negative tumor with less morphologic evidence of metastatic potential and no nodal involvement.
classes.1: Node-positive tumor with aggressive features such as lymphovascular invasion, infiltrative borders, or poor differentiation suggesting nodal spread.
